blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Every multilingual speech pipeline begins with a language decision, an error there propagates silently through recognition, translation and routing. In India it spans 22 scheduled languages across four language families, heard over short, noisy, narrowband and code-mixed audio. Foundational speech models increasingly present language identification (LID) as an inherent latent, generalized capability. Autoregressive decoders in speech models emit a special language ID token, and modern LLMs with audio capabilities can name the language when prompted. We test this assumption on identical clips and find that whisper and similar speech models has tokens for only 15 of the 23 languages, on one second inputs Gemini 3.5 Flash reaches 0.52 macro-F1 and GPT-audio 0.14. We present Anuvani LID, a dedicated 115M parameter LID conformer model trained on 54,643 hours of Indian speech spanning 22 Indian languages and Indian accented English. Along with designed and controlled studies on 102 condition benchmark with speaker and corpus held out tests. Across 37 conditions, it reaches 0.914 mean macro-F1, 5.2 points above Gemini 3.5 Flash and ahead of 14 other systems. It is 24 points ahead of Gemini at one second, scores 0.897 on all 23 languages where no other system exceeds 0.713, and is calibrated to an ECE of 0.008. Reliable Indian LID still requires a robust, dedicated and calibrated model.
blocks.zh: 每一个多语种的语音管道都从语言决定开始, 在印度,它跨越了四个语言家庭的22种排期语言,在短、吵闹、窄带和密码混合的音频中听到。 基础语音模型越来越多地将语言识别(LID)作为一种内在的潜在和普遍能力。 语音模型中的自动递归解码器会发出一个特殊语言ID符号,具有音频能力的现代LLMS可以在被提示时命名语言. 我们用相同的剪辑测试这个假设,发现低语和类似语音模型只有23种语言中的15种有符号,在一秒输入双子座3.5 Flash达到0.52宏F1和GPT-audio0.14. 我们介绍Anuvani LID, 一种专用的115M参数LID符合模式, 连同102个条件基准的设计和有控制的研究,用扬声器和装置进行了测试。 在37个条件中,它达到了0.914平均值-F1,比双子座3.5 Flash高5.2分,领先其他14个系统. 在没有其他系统超过0.713的所有23种语言中,比双子座领先24分,得分0.897分,并被校准为0.08的ECE. 可靠的印度LID仍然需要一个坚固,专注和校准的模型.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spoken language identification (LID) is the first decision in almost every multilingual speech pipeline: it chooses the recogniser, the translation direction and the language a helpline or assistant answers in ( Li et al., 2013 ) . An error here propagates; a Maithili call sent to a Hindi recogniser degrades every later component. In India this decision is usually hard and complex. The Eighth Schedule lists 22 languages from four language families, the mother tongues of 96.7% of the 1.21 billion people counted in 2011 ( ORGI, 2018 ) . Many are close relatives, our training audio ranges from 13,039 h (Indian accented English) to 369 h (Kashmiri) in our pool, and deployed audio is short, noisy, narrowband and code-mixed (§ 2 ).
blocks.zh: 口语识别(LID)是几乎所有多语种语音管道中的第一个决定:它选择识别器,翻译方向和语言的帮助热线或助理答案(Li等,2013年). 错误在这里传播; 发送到印地语识别器的 Maithili 呼叫会降低每个后期组件 。 在印度,这个决定通常是困难而复杂的。 第八表列出了来自四个语言家庭的22种语言,2011年统计的12.1亿人中的96.7%为母语(ORGI, 2018. 许多是近亲,我们训练的音频从13,039 h(印度口音为英语)到369 h(Kashmiri)不等,部署的音频短而吵,窄带和密码混合(§2).

blocks.en: Speech foundational models represent LID task as a latent, in-context generalised capability. Whisper decoder decodes a language ID token before it transcribes ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , Meta’s MMS models attaches a 4,017 language identification head ( Pratap et al., 2024 ) , and LLMs with audio capabilities such as Gemini and GPT-audio name the language of a clip when asked ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . Dedicated LID models might therefore seem obsolete. For Indian languages, our measurements argue otherwise (§ 6 ): • Coverage is incomplete. Whisper has tokens for only 15 of the 23 classes (22 scheduled languages plus English), and among open systems only Voxlect covers all 23. • Short inputs break generalist systems. At one second audio length, Gemini 3.5 Flash reaches 0.52 macro-F1 and GPT-audio 0.14. At sub one second, most speech models fail. • Errors matter even at foundation-model scale. Most of Whisper’s supposed Welsh translation data turned out to be English audio misclassified by its language identifier ( Radford et al., 2023 ) . Even at the scale of Gemini 3.5 Flash, errors matter. • Deployment needs calibrated scores and small models. Routing and rejection need calibrated confidence, which hard-label APIs often lack, and Whisper-large-v3 has 1.55B parameters ( OpenAI, 2023 ) , 13 times more than Anuvani-LID.
blocks.zh: 语音基础模型代表LID任务是一种潜在的、内在的通用能力。 Whisper decoder在它转录前会解码一个语言ID符号(Radford等,2023年),Meta的MMS模型会附加一个4,017个语言识别头(Pratap等,2024年),以及有音频能力的LLMs,如双子座和GPT-audio在被问到时会将剪辑语言命名(Google DeepMind,2026;OpenAI,2024年). 专门 因此,LID模式可能似乎已经过时。 就印度语言而言,我们的衡量标准是相反的(第6节): • 在开放系统中,只有Voxlect涵盖全部23个课程。 短投入会打破通论体系. 在一秒的音频长度上,双子座3.5 Flash达到0.52宏-F1和GPT-Audio0.14. 在子一秒,大多数的语音模型都失败了. • 错误即使在基础模型规模上也是重要的。 大部分Whisper认为的威尔士语翻译数据, 即使是双子座 3.5 Flash的规模,错误也是重要的. • 部署需要校准分数和小型模型。 寻常和拒常需要校正自信,硬标签API往往缺乏这种信心,而Whisper-大V3有1.55B参数(OpenAI,2023),比Anuvani-LID多出13倍.

blocks.en: A further obstacle is methodological. Clean, in-domain test sets saturate: in our pilot study every head reached about 98% macro-averaged accuracy, within 1 pp of the others. Following work on saturation and shortcut learning ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ; Kiela et al., 2021 ) , we rebuilt the evaluation pipeline first and took every later decision on held-out, multi-axis conditions. We report the programme in the order it was carried out. Our contributions are: • SUITE-102 , a 102-condition, 318,861-utterance benchmark with speaker- and corpus-held-out tiers, and SUITE-42 , which scores 15 open and commercial systems on identical clips (§ 4 ). • A staged, controlled study of fine-tuning a self-supervised Conformer for LID (§ 5 ). • Anuvani-LID , which leads all 15 systems (Figure 1 ), most clearly on short, noisy and all-23-language conditions, and is well calibrated (§ 6 ). • A linguistic error analysis (§ 7 ) and a layer analysis showing that 12 of 17 blocks suffice (§ 8 ).

blocks.en: The Eighth Schedule for Indian languages grew from 14 to 22 languages through additions in 1967, 1992 and 2004 ( Government of India, 2026 ; MHA, 2017 ) . The 2011 Census rationalised 19,569 raw mother-tongue returns into 1,369 mother tongues and 121 languages ( ORGI, 2018 ) . Speaker numbers span four orders of magnitude, from Hindi (528M) to Sanskrit (24,821), and training data does not track them (Table 1 ; Figure 2 ). The labels are administrative: the Census “Hindi” groups 56 mother tongues, including Bhojpuri (50.6M), and Maithili was counted under Hindi until 2001 ( ORGI, 2018 ) , so class boundaries are partly conventional ( MHA, 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 通过1967年、1992年和2004年的增补,印度语言第八个表从14个增加到22个(印度政府,2026;MHA,2017.)。 2011年人口普查将19,569个生母语的回音合理化为1,369个母语和121个语言(ORGI,2018. 演讲者人数从印地语(528M)到梵语(24,821)有四个数量级,培训数据没有跟踪(表1;图2)。 这些标签是行政性的: 人口普查"Hindi"组56个母语,包括Bhojpuri(50.6M),而Maithili直到2001年(ORGI, 2018年)才在印地语下被计算在内,因此类边界部分是常规的(MHA, 2017年).

blocks.en: Fifteen scheduled languages are Indo-Aryan, four Dravidian, two Tibeto-Burman and one Austroasiatic ( Hammarström et al., 2026 ) . Genealogy understates how alike they sound. Emeneau (1956) described India as a linguistic area in which languages of all families share retroflex consonants, verb-final clauses and echo words ( Masica, 1976 ) , and retroflex systems are distributed geographically rather than genetically ( Arsenault, 2017 ) . Indian LID work reports heavily overlapping phone sets ( Vuddagiri et al., 2018 ; Dey et al., 2022 ) , and on FLEURS the South Asian group has the lowest LID accuracy ( Conneau et al., 2023 ) . Several classes are sisters or former dialects. Hindi and Urdu share colloquial Hindustani ( Kachru, 2008 ) , and Urdu → \to Hindi is VoxLingua107’s most common error ( Valk and Alumäe, 2021 ) . Grierson treated Dogri as a dialect of Punjabi and Konkani as one of Marathi ( Grierson, 1916 ; Grierson, 1905 ) , and these pairs share 93% and 80–82% of basic vocabulary ( Kogan, 2016 ) . Script, which separates Hindi from Urdu (“one language, two scripts”; King, 1994 ), is absent from speech. The remaining evidence is sparse in short clips: degree of retroflexion, laryngeal contrasts, vowel length, and lexical tone in Punjabi, Dogri, Bodo and Meitei.

blocks.en: Several scheduled languages are sisters or former “dialects” of one another: • Hindi and Urdu are sister languoids under Hindustani and share a colloquial form ( Hammarström et al., 2026 ; Kachru, 2008 ) . Urdu → \to Hindi is the single most common error in VoxLingua107 ( Valk and Alumäe, 2021 ) . • Punjabi and Dogri share 93% of basic vocabulary ( Kogan, 2016 ) , and Grierson (1916) described Dogri as a dialect of Punjabi. • Grierson (1905) likewise treated Konkani as a Marathi dialect; the two share 80–82% of basic vocabulary. • Assamese, Bengali and Odia share 86–88% of basic vocabulary and one Glottolog node, and they share numeral-classifier morphology with Maithili ( Emeneau, 1956 ) . • Maithili speakers from the eastern dialect area commonly shift to Hindi when talking with speakers from other areas ( Central Institute of Indian Languages, n.d. ) . Lexicostatistics measures vocabulary, not acoustics, but these are exactly the pairs where LID systems err (§ 7 ).

blocks.en: Script is absent from speech. Devanagari alone serves at least ten of the classes ( Unicode Consortium, 2026 ) . Hindi and Urdu, famously “one language, two scripts” ( King, 1994 ) , are written in Devanagari and Perso-Arabic respectively. Labels must therefore come from corpus metadata rather than from transcripts. The discriminative evidence is phonetic, phonotactic and prosodic: • Degree of retroflexion : Tamil exceeds Hindi, and Nepali retroflexes are weaker still ( Keane, 2004 ; Khatiwada, 2009 ) . • Laryngeal series : Hindi has a four-way stop series ( Ohala, 1994 ) , and Gujarati contrasts breathy and modal voice on vowels ( Esposito and Khan, 2012 ) . • Vowel length : contrastive in Dravidian languages but not in Bengali or Assamese ( Keane, 2004 ; Khan, 2010 ; Mahanta, 2012 ) . • Lexical tone : documented in Punjabi and Dogri and in Bodo and Meitei ( Evans et al., 2018 ; Das and Mahanta, 2019 ; Devi and Das, 2024 ) . • Rare segments : Sindhi implosives and Santali checked finals ( Maddieson, 2013 ; The Unicode Consortium, 2025 ) . Many of these cues are sparse, and a one-second clip may contain none of them. This is consistent with duration, rather than noise, being the dominant difficulty axis (§ 6 ).
blocks.zh: 脚本不在语音中 。 Devanagari一人至少为10个班级提供服务(Unicode Consortium,2026.). 印地语和乌尔都语分别用德瓦纳加里语和佩尔索-阿拉伯语写作,著名的是“一种语言,两种文字”(国王,1994年)。 因此,标签必须来自实体元数据,而不是记录誊本。 歧义证据有口相声,口相声和口相声: 反相声的程度:泰米尔语超过印地语,而尼泊尔语反相声仍然较弱(Keane,2004;Khatiwada,2009) . Layngeal系列:印地语有四行止相相相声系列(Ohala,1994),而古吉拉特语在元音上反相声和模式相声(Esposito和Khan,2012)。 Vowel长度:在德拉维德语系语言中具有对比性,但在孟加拉语或阿萨姆语系中没有对比性(Keane,2004;Khan,2010;Mahanta,2012). ^ 语法基调:在旁遮普语和多格里语以及博多语和美地语中都有记载(Evans等,2018;Das和Mahanta,2019;Devi和Das,2024). 稀有区段 : Sindhi implosives and Santali 检查了决赛(Maddieson,2013;The Unicode Consortium,2025.). 许多这些提示是稀有的,一秒钟的片段可能没有包含其中的任何一分. 这与持续时间一致,而不是与作为主要困难轴的噪音一致(第6节)。

blocks.en: The 23rd class is Indian accented English. Every English hour in our pool comes from Indian speakers, consisting of NPTEL lectures (10,441 h), NLTM collections (1,252 h), ULCA (916 h) and Indic TIMIT (234 h; Yarra et al., 2019 ), and we evaluate on Indian-accented sets such as Svarah ( Javed et al., 2023b ) . Kachru (1986) called Indian English “an Indian language in its own right”; 128.5M Indians speak it, nearly all as a second or third language ( ORGI, 2011 ) . Its accent is at once uniform and variable ( Wiltshire, 2020 ; Sailaja, 2009 ; Pandey, 2015 ) . Pan-Indian features include apical, often retroflex /t d/, stops for /T D/, merged /v/–/w/ and unaspirated voiceless stops ( Masica, 1972 ) , and a rhythm that differs from British English in duration, loudness, pitch and glottal stops ( Fuchs, 2016 ) . Beneath them, the mother tongue shapes vowels, rhotics, diphthongs and pitch accents ( Wiltshire and Harnsberger, 2006 ; Maxwell and Fletcher, 2010 ) . Svarah’s 117 speakers from 65 districts cover 19 first languages, and Whisper’s word error rate rises from 2.7% on LibriSpeech to 7.2% on it ( Javed et al., 2023b ) . For LID this cuts both ways. The English class must absorb all this variation, and each English utterance carries traces of the very languages the model must also recognise (§ 7 ).
blocks.zh: 23等为印度口音为英语. 我们池里的每个英语小时都来自印度语,包括NPTEL讲座(10,441 h),NLTM集(1,252 h),ULCA(916 h)和Indic TIMIT(234 h;Yarra等,2019)等,我们评价了由印度人所聚集的Svarah(Javed等,2023b.)等套集. Kachru (1986)称印度英语为"本身的印度语";128.5M印第安人讲它,几乎都是第二或第三语言(ORGI,2011年). 其口音一并统一并可变(Wiltshire,2020;Sailaja,2009;Pandey,2015.). 泛印地语的特征有: 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在他们下方,母语会塑造元音,rhotics,diphthongs和发音(Wiltshire和Harnsberger,2006;Maxwell和Fletcher,2010. Svarah来自65个区的117位演讲者覆盖了19个第一语言,而Whisper的词错误率从LibriSpeech的2.7%上升到了其中的7.2%(Javed等,2023年b). 对LID来说,这双向切开。 英语课必须吸收所有这些变化,每个英语课都带有模型必须识别的语言的痕迹(第7节)。

blocks.en: In 2011, 26.0% of Indians reported a second language and 7.1% a third ( ORGI, 2022 ) . About 17% of Hindi–English social-media posts are code-mixed ( Bali et al., 2014 ) . In code-switched speech, more than half of the embedded segments last only 200–400 ms ( Barras et al., 2020 ) , so the matrix language is the natural utterance label.
blocks.zh: 2011年,26.0%的印度人报告了第二语言,7.1%报告了第三语言(ORGI,2022年). 大约17%的印地语-英语社交媒体文章是密码混合的(Bali等,2014年). 在密码开关的语音中,超过半数被嵌入的片段只能持续200–400 ms(Barras等,2020年),因此矩阵语言是自然的语音标签.

blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: LID moved from i-vectors ( Li et al., 2013 ) to x-vectors ( Snyder et al., 2018b ; Snyder et al., 2018a ) and ECAPA-TDNN ( Desplanques et al., 2020 ) , with VoxLingua107 ( Valk and Alumäe, 2021 ) behind common open baselines ( SpeechBrain, 2021 ; Jia et al., 2023 ) . Self-supervised (SSL) speech encoders now dominate the space with XLS-R and MMS type models as well as dedicate finetune’s wav2vec 2.0-style models exists ( Babu et al., 2022 ; Pratap et al., 2024 ; Baevski et al., 2020 ) , and Bartley et al. (2023) fine-tune an SSL Conformer. NIST LRE defines cluster-aware evaluation with C avg C_{\text{avg}} ( Sadjadi et al., 2018 ; NIST, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: LID从i-vectors(Li等,2013年)转移到x-vectors(Snyder等,2018b;Snyder等,2018a)和ECAPA-TDNN(Desplanques等,2020年),VoxLingua107(Valk和Alumäe,2021年)位于共同开放基线后(SpeechBrain,2021;Jia等,2023年). 自我监督的(SSL)语音编码器现在以XLS-R和MMS类型模型主导空间,以及专用微调的wav2vec 2.0型模型也存在(Babu等,2022;Pratap等,2024;Baevski等,2020;Bartley等,2023)微调了SSL Conformer. NIST LRE 用 Cavg C_{\text{avg}}} 定义群集意识评价 (Sadjadi等,2018;NIST,2022).

blocks.en: IIITH-ILSC ( Vuddagiri et al., 2018 ) introduced a 23-class benchmark. Later systems added CTC features ( Mandava et al., 2019 ) or fine-tuned XLSR-53 ( Gupta et al., 2023 ; Rajak et al., 2025 ) . Cross-corpus generalisation is the central difficulty for such models: EER rises from 11.8% in-corpus to 43.3% cross-corpus ( Dey et al., 2021 ) , and acoustic augmentation and bias compensation recovers only part of it ( Dey et al., 2023 ; Dey et al., 2024 ) . Surveys and layer studies include Dey et al. (2022) and Dey and Saha (2025) . On IndicSUPERB, 12-language LID accuracy falls from 98.2% on seen to 90.8% on unseen speakers ( Javed et al., 2023a ) , and Basu et al. (2026) compare encoders for 42 Indic languages. We differ in scale (54.6k h), converging all 23 spoken language classes, held-out multi-axis evaluation, and comparison with commercial audio LLMs. We build upon the MahaDhwani encoder, which was pretrained w2v-BERT-style on 279k h of Indian audio ( Bhogale et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: IIITH-ILSC(Vuddagiri等,2018年)引入了23等基准. 后来的系统增加了CTC特征(Mandava等,2019年)或微调XLSR-53(Gupta等,2023年;Rajak等,2025年). Cross-corpus generation是此类模型的核心难题:EER从公司内部的11.8%上升到了43.3%的Cross-corpus(Dey等人,2021年),而声学增强和偏差补偿只恢复了部分(Dey等人,2023年;Dey等人,2024年). 调查和地层研究包括德伊等(2022年)和德伊与萨哈(2025年). 在IndexSUPERB上,12个语言的LID精度从所见的98.2%下降到所见的90.8%(Javed等人,2023a)和Basu等人。 (2026)比较42种印地语的编码器. 我们的规模不同(54.6k h),将所有23个口语班合并起来,保留多轴评价,并与商业音频LLMs进行比较。 我们利用印度音频279kh的马哈德瓦尼编码器(Bhogale等,2025年;Chung等,2021年)。

blocks.en: 4 SUITE-102: A De-saturated Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 SUITE-102: 一个去饱和基准

blocks.en: SUITE-102 probes LID along the multi-domain axes on which deployed systems fail (composition in Appendix Table 4 ). Its headline tier is the IndicVoices test set ( Javed et al., 2024a ) : 300 spontaneous utterances per language for all 23 classes, from 1,308 speakers, none of whom is among the 34,034 IndicVoices speakers in our training data. Cross-corpus tiers use the evaluation splits of FLEURS, SPRING-INX, MUCS, Kathbath and Common Voice ( Conneau et al., 2023 ; Nithya R et al., 2023 ; Diwan et al., 2021 ; Javed et al., 2023a ; Ardila et al., 2020 ) . The clip-level carve has an empty intersection with training, and transcript fingerprinting finds no FLEURS or MUCS overlap. Variety probes cover dialectal Hindi ( Javed et al., 2024b ) , Hinglish ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , Indian-accented English ( Javed et al., 2023b ) , studio speech ( Baby et al., 2016 ) , lectures ( AI4Bharat, 2020 ) and rural telephony ( Bhanushali et al., 2022 ) . Each source is expanded into random and VAD-anchored crops of 0.25–10 s, MUSAN noise at 0 and 5 dB ( Snyder et al., 2015 ) , reverberation ( Ko et al., 2017 ) , G.711 μ \mu -law telephony, babble, confusable-cluster subsets and open-set trials. The open-set trials use music, eight non-Indian languages and Chhattisgarhi, a relative of Hindi outside the label set. Curation is deterministic, and the suite was frozen before the final training run.
blocks.zh: SUITE-102探测器沿部署系统失败的多领域轴进行LID(由附录表4所构成)。 其头等号是Indioices测试集(Javed等,2024a):所有23个课程,每门语言自发发表300个演讲,其中1 308个演讲者没有一位是我国培训数据中34 034个Indioices演讲者。 跨公司级采用FLEURS,SPRING-INX,MUCS,Kathbath和共同之声的评价分数(Conneau等,2023;Nithya R等,2023;Diwan等,2021;Javed等,2023a;Ardila等,2020.). 剪接平面刻有与训练的空相相接处,抄本指纹发现没有FLEURS或MUCS重叠. 多样性探测器覆盖了方言印地语(Javed等人,2024年b),Hinglish (Singh等,2025年),印度语发音为英语(Javed等,2023b.),工作室演讲(Baby等,2016.),讲座(AI4Bharat,2020.)和乡村电话(Bhanushali等,2022. 每个来源被扩展为:0.25-10 s的随机和VAD-活泼作物,0和5 dB的MUSAN噪声(Snyder等,2015年),反响(Ko等,2017年),G.711 μ\mu - law电话,bulble,confuse-cluster子集和开机试验. 开放的设定试验使用音乐,8种非印地语和Chhattisgarhi,是标签套外印地语的亲戚. 咒语是决定性的,在最后的训练开始前,套房被冻结了.

blocks.en: Commercial APIs are too costly to run on the full suite, so we drew a balanced panel of 42 conditions with up to 150 utterances per language in each. The core panel has 37 conditions (47,730 clips) over the ten languages every system supports: Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi and Urdu. The all-23 panel has five IndicVoices conditions (17,229 clips). Every system receives identical audio. Prompted audio LLMs and Azure receive the candidate list (10 or 23 languages), Sarvam Saaras runs in auto-detect mode, and open models predict over their native label sets. Anuvani-LID always predicts over all 23 classes, so it can make errors that a 10-candidate system cannot. We also report it restricted to the same ten candidates (“matched”).
blocks.zh: 商业 API的花费太高,不能在全套的套房上运行,所以我们画出一个42个条件的平衡的面板,每种语言的每个词最多150个. 核心面板对每个系统支持的10种语言有37个条件(47,730个片段):印地语,孟加拉语,泰米尔语,泰卢固语,马拉地语,古吉拉特语,坎纳达语,马来亚拉姆语,旁遮普语和乌尔都语. 全23面板有5个IndiocVoices条件(17,229个片段). 每个系统都接收到相同的音频. 被启动的音频LLMs和Azure接收候选列表(10或23种语言),Sarvam Saaras以自动检测模式运行,并开放模型对其本土的标签集进行预测. Anuvani-LID总是预测所有23个班级,因此它可以出错,一个10个candidate系统不能. 我们还报告说,它仅限于同十个候选人(“对应的”)。

blocks.en: The primary metric is macro-F1 over the languages present in a condition. We also report top-1 accuracy, C avg C_{\text{avg}} ( NIST, 2022 ) , EER, 15-bin ECE ( Pakdaman Naeini et al., 2015 ; Guo et al., 2017 ) , and open-set AUROC from maximum softmax probability ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ) . Intervals are 1,000-resample bootstraps ( Bisani and Ney, 2004 ) (300, stratified by condition, for paired differences), and paired items are tested with McNemar’s test ( McNemar, 1947 ; Gillick and Cox, 1989 ) under Holm or Bonferroni correction ( Holm, 1979 ) .
blocks.zh: 主要衡量尺度是宏-F1,而不是条件下的语言。 我们还报告最高一等准确度,Cavg C_{\text{avg}}(NIST,2022年),EER,15-bin ECE(Pakdaman Naeini等,2015年;Guo等,2017年),以及从最大软离子概率(Hendrycks和Gimpel,2017年)的开放式AUROC。 相接物为1000反相模靴(Bisani and Ney, 2004) (300,按条件分级,为配对差异),并配对物品由麦克内马尔测试(McNemar,1947;Gillick and Cox,1989)在Holm或Bonferroni校正下进行测试(Holm,1979).

blocks.en: 5.2 A staged research programme

blocks.en:
The recipe is the outcome of six stages run in order, each starting from the previous stage’s promoted recipe (Appendix Table 5 ). Stages I–V ran at reduced scale (1,000–4,000 h) so that many controlled arms were affordable; Stage VI trained once on all 54,643 h, so that recipes here onwards could be validated on the full scale of training data.
Each stage answers one question with arms that change one axis at a time against the recipe it inherits, and architecture, sampling and augmentation are judged on held-out conditions (§ 4 ) rather than on in-domain validation accuracy, which saturates.
blocks.zh:
配方是按顺序分出六个阶段的结果,每个阶段从前一阶段推广的配方开始(附录表5)。 第一至第五阶段的规模缩小(1 000至4 000小时),使许多受管制的武器能够负担得起;第六阶段对所有54 643小时进行了一次培训,以便在此之后的食谱能够全面验证培训数据。
每个阶段都用武器回答一个问题,即一次对照它继承的食谱改变一轴,而结构、取样和增强则根据搁置条件(§ 4)进行判断,而不是根据域内验证的准确性进行判断,这种验证是饱和的。

blocks.en: The first decision was the optimiser, because the heads under comparison differ in trainable size by two orders of magnitude, from LoRA adapters to an ECAPA-TDNN fine-tuned end to end. ULMFiT-style discriminative rates ( Howard and Ruder, 2018 ) , a larger step for the freshly initialised head than for the pre-trained encoder, are the usual prescription for this setting. We tested them against a single global rate on three heads that span the range, attentive pooling, NetVLAD and ECAPA-TDNN, for 1,500 steps each. A head rate ten times the encoder’s ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} against 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) gave the large NetVLAD head nothing (0.980 against 0.982 macro-averaged validation accuracy) and destabilised the angular-margin attentive head, so a single global rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , at which the pre-trained encoder and the new head co-adapt stably, became the default for every fully fine-tuned arm.

We trained 25 arms on a balanced 1,000 h subset of 20 languages (Kashmiri, Santali and Sindhi had too little audio) and scored them on the 54-condition predecessor of SUITE-102 (Figure 4 ). Every arm shared one recipe apart from the axis under test: AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with β = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) \beta{=}(0.9,0.98) and weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 10% linear warm-up and cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} , 144 utterances per step, temperature sampling at T = 2 T{=}2 , bf16 and four epochs.
Three findings shaped the model: • Pooling matters little. Under an additive angular margin (AAM) loss, statistics ( Snyder et al., 2018b ) , multi-head ( India et al., 2019 ) , NetVLAD ( Arandjelović et al., 2016 ) , ECAPA-TDNN ( Desplanques et al., 2020 ) and attentive pooling over aggregated layers all land within 0.825–0.837 cross-corpus macro-F1, with overlapping intervals. • The loss decides calibration. Cosine-margin heads ( Deng et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2018 ) emit bounded, rescaled cosines, and fine-tuned cosine-margin heads have an ECE of 0.75–0.79; softmax heads reach 0.02–0.08 (0.13 under distillation). With attentive pooling, focal loss has the highest macro-F1 of all 25 arms (0.840) and an ECE of 0.023, 2.6 × \times below cross-entropy, in line with Mukhoti et al. (2020) ; layer aggregation, however, classifies 1.1% more items correctly on top-1, so we kept both. • The encoder must be fine-tuned. A frozen encoder reaches only 0.362, and top-6 fine-tuning (0.806), adapters (0.822; Houlsby et al., 2019 ) and LoRA (0.821; Hu et al., 2022 ) all trail full fine-tuning. These partial regimes ran at the larger rates prescribed for small trainable budgets, 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the frozen encoder’s head, for bottleneck adapters of width 64 and for LoRA of rank 8 ( α = 16 \alpha{=}16 ), and 3 × 10 − 4 3{\times}10^{-4} for the top six blocks, and the frozen encoder trails full fine-tuning by 48 points. ECAPA-TDNN ( Desplanques et al., 2020 ) , explored in 12 arms, was set aside: its deep head drives the arccos-based ArcFace to divergence, it over-corrects under focal loss and under self-distillation ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , and no ECAPA arm passes attentive pooling with focal loss on cross-corpus macro-F1 (0.835 against 0.840) despite 23M extra parameters. Fusing arms promises up to 11.1 points on short utterances under an oracle, but majority vote recovers almost none of it, so we kept a single network, the simplest arm at the top of the cross-corpus ranking: attentive statistics pooling, focal loss and full fine-tuning.

blocks.en: • Temperature sampling gains with training length. The T = 2 T{=}2 recipe trained for two epochs instead of one improves every axis: in-domain macro-F1 rises from 0.946 to 0.958, pooled cross-corpus macro-F1 from 0.919 to 0.931, confusable pairs from 0.885 to 0.909, degraded audio from 0.832 to 0.852 and open-set AUROC from 0.829 to 0.840. The second epoch lifts every resource tier, the two sub-500 h languages from 0.930 to 0.970 and the eight largest from 0.935 to 0.943, so a longer schedule recovers more than half of the head accuracy that a single epoch of up-sampling had traded away. • Focal loss complements temperature sampling. The two act on different quantities. Temperature sampling sets how often each language is seen; focal loss sets how much each example counts once seen, scaling its loss by ( 1 − p y ) γ (1-p_{y})^{\gamma} so that confidently classified examples fade and hard ones dominate the gradient. The sampler corrects class frequency and the loss corrects example difficulty, so neither undoes the other. Stage I measured what focal loss adds on its own: on the same attentive head it raises cross-corpus macro-F1 by 0.86 points over the angular-margin loss while cutting ECE from 0.788 to 0.023, it nearly triples cross-corpus recall of Dogri, the hardest tail language (0.075 to 0.20), and against cross-entropy it is 2.6 times better calibrated at slightly higher accuracy (0.840 against 0.836). Within focal loss, γ = 1 \gamma{=}1 matches γ = 2 \gamma{=}2 , and γ = 3 \gamma{=}3 gains 1.0 point cross-corpus and 3.6 points at 1 s but raises ECE to 0.078, so γ = 2 \gamma{=}2 stays as the calibrated setting. Rebalancing must happen once, in the sampler or in the loss. As the sole rebalancer, logit adjustment ( Menon et al., 2021 ) at T = 1 T{=}1 matches temperature sampling on the four plain cross-corpus sets (0.925 against 0.925 at T = 3 T{=}3 ) and is the best-calibrated arm of the stage (ECE 0.011 against 0.046 for plain focal loss at T = 1 T{=}1 ). On top of T = 2 T{=}2 it counts the prior twice: in-domain macro-F1 falls 3.5 points and the two largest classes collapse, English from 0.906 to 0.699 F1 and Hindi from 0.713 to 0.344. A two-stage schedule, one epoch of uniform sampling followed by one of natural sampling, lifts in-domain macro-F1 to 0.964 against 0.958 for two single-stage epochs, but weakens open-set separation (AUROC 0.798 against 0.840), so the single-stage sampler stayed. At equal budget, learned layer aggregation raises in-domain macro-F1 from 0.958 to 0.967 and improves every acoustic family (telephony +2.8 pp), so we adopted it; it also lowers 100 ⋅ C avg 100\cdot C_{\text{avg}} from 2.23 to 1.72.

blocks.en: Eight operations make up the final recipe (Table 2 ). Six act on the waveform as each clip leaves the data loader, always in the same order: speed perturbation ( Ko et al., 2015 ) , additive noise from MUSAN ( Snyder et al., 2015 ) , reverberation with simulated room impulse responses ( Ko et al., 2017 ) , the duration crop, babble and the codec. Noise therefore enters before the room response and is reverberated with the speech, babble is mixed in at the cropped length, and the telephone channel acts last, on the whole mixture, as it does in a call. The other two are the frequency and time masks of SpecAugment ( Park et al., 2019 ) , applied to the log-Mel features of every training example. Each waveform transform is selected independently for every clip, with a fixed probability that depends on neither the language nor the corpus, so no transform can become a cue for a class, and its parameters are drawn afresh each time. The six selections give 64 combinations. Over the 61.2M training examples of the final run, 102.5k h of source audio, 93.5% pass through at least one waveform transform and 6.5% reach the masks unaltered. A clip receives 2.1 waveform transforms on average, and 70.3% receive two or more. Speed perturbation picks one of five rates from 0.95 to 1.05 and leaves the clip as it is at the identity rate, so it changes 40% of clips. Half of the clips are selected for cropping, but a crop from the long branch, uniform between 3 s and the clip’s own length, cannot shorten a clip of 3 s or less, so 44.9% are shortened; a quarter of all examples, 15.3M, are cut to between 0.25 and 3 s. Noise comes from 930 MUSAN recordings, and reverberation from 60,000 impulse responses simulated in 600 rooms, 200 each small, medium and large. Babble sums one to six talkers drawn from 10,426 recordings: the 426 speech recordings of MUSAN, as in x-vector training ( Snyder et al., 2018b ) , and 10,000 training clips spread over all 23 languages. The codec band-limits to 4 kHz by resampling through 8 kHz and applies 8-bit G.711 μ \mu -law companding ( ITU-T, 1988 ) . The Stage III arms used the same probabilities, with a single uniform crop of 0.5–16 s, and babble only in its own arm.

blocks.en: Stages I–III fix what the model sees; Stage IV asks whether the order in which it sees it adds more ( Bengio et al., 2009 ) . We expected the largest return where the static recipe left most error: on the confusable Indo-Aryan cluster, the weakest clean axis of Stage II (0.909 macro-F1 on confusable pairs), and on sub-second input. Following the decomposition of a curriculum into a difficulty measure and a training scheduler ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , we screened four definitions of difficulty under one competence schedule ( Platanios et al., 2019 ) , p ⁡ ( e ) = min ⁡ ( 1 , e ⁡ ( 1 − p 0 2 ) / ( N − 1 ) + p 0 2 ) p(e)=\min\bigl(1,\sqrt{e\,(1-p_{0}^{2})/(N-1)+p_{0}^{2}}\bigr) with p 0 = 0.2 p_{0}{=}0.2 , which moves an axis from its easy end to its hard end over N N epochs. Each arm changed one axis of the Stage III recipe (4,000 h, three epochs) and had to lift its target without regressing any resource tier or language: • Duration. Training crops shrink from 6.6 to 2.95 to 1.0 s, replacing the static random crop. This inverts SortaGrad ( Amodei et al., 2016 ) : a short clip is easy for recognition but carries less evidence for LID. • Resource. The sampling temperature rises from 1.2 to 2.0, so the head dominates early and the tail gains weight late, after the annealed language sampling of mmBERT ( Marone et al., 2025 ) ; a reverse schedule, from 1.8 to 1.0, controls for direction. • Confusability. The 15 Indo-Aryan languages enter at 0.36 of their temperature-sampled weight, rising to 0.78 and then 1.0, so the Dravidian, Tibeto-Burman and Austroasiatic languages and English are seen at full weight first and the cluster in which most confusions arise (§ 7 ) is brought in gradually. • Self-paced. Within each batch only the lowest-loss 68% of examples enter the loss, rising to all of them ( Kumar et al., 2010 ) . Ordering by duration gives the largest short-input gain of any curriculum. Against the unscheduled recipe trained for the same three epochs, it lifts mean macro-F1 over five corpora from 0.42–0.43 to 0.52 at 0.5 s and from 0.17–0.18 to 0.26 at 0.25 s. Because ending training on one-second crops also shortens what the model hears of full-length speech, the final recipe takes the same short-crop exposure from the bimodal crop of Stage III, which keeps long segments in every batch. The model-driven gate did not add to the unscheduled recipe.

blocks.en: The final recipe schedules the language mix. It keeps the confusability curriculum, which acts on the cluster that carries most errors, composes with temperature sampling by changing which languages fill a batch as training proceeds rather than how often each is drawn relative to its size, and costs nothing at inference. At full scale its competence ramp spans the 17 sub-epochs of 25k steps that make up the 425k-step budget: after a first sub-epoch on the plain temperature mix, the weight of the Indo-Aryan cluster rises from 0.45 to 1.0 (Figure 7 ), on top of T = 1.75 T{=}1.75 and the language floors of Stage V. The schedule is applied in the streaming shard reader exactly as in the reference sampler (the language distributions agree to 10 − 13 10^{-13} ), and the final run logs it at every sub-epoch. We chose this curriculum on the evidence of the ablations. Confusable pairs were the weakest clean axis of Stage II (0.909 macro-F1), and the Indo-Aryan cluster carries most of the remaining errors: 65–66% of those of the unscheduled three-epoch recipe on the all-23 test. Each of the other three curricula either acts elsewhere or would move a tuned setting. The bimodal crop of Stage III already supplies the short-crop exposure of the duration curriculum while keeping long segments in every batch, the model-driven gate did not add to the unscheduled recipe, and the resource curriculum keeps the sampling temperature away from T = 2 T{=}2 , where the inverted U of Stage II peaks, for most of training. The confusability curriculum alone targets the dominant error while keeping temperature sampling and the language floors as tuned, and it returns to the tuned mix by the last sub-epoch.

blocks.en: Short probes on the 4,000 h proxy set the optimiser. This proxy was redrawn from the final 54,643 h pool with the Stage II construction, so its language ratios match the full pool. Learning rates of 3 × 10 − 5 3{\times}10^{-5} to 10 − 3 10^{-3} gave development accuracies of 0.771–0.876; we took the knee at 3 × 10 − 4 3{\times}10^{-4} , since the last step added only 0.5 pp. Short horizons flatter large rates, so we checked the choice at length: at 3 × 10 − 4 3{\times}10^{-4} development accuracy reached 0.941 after 25k steps, a level the earlier 10 − 4 10^{-4} recipe needed about 46k steps to reach. Warm-ups of 5–15% and temperatures of 1.5–2.5 were flat within 1.2 pp, so we chose T = 1.75 T{=}1.75 with floors keeping English at 16% and Hindi at 11% of samples. T = 1.75 T{=}1.75 is the value at which the full augmentation stack, babble included, was validated, and because the proxy keeps the pool’s language ratios, the same temperature yields the same sampling mix at full scale; only the number of repetitions grows. The floors protect the two largest classes. Temperature sampling alone would give English 12.3% and Hindi 10.6% of draws, and under focal loss, which discounts easy examples, that leaves the head too little exposure; the Hindi floor also guards the Hindi–Urdu boundary. We sized the budget by effective passes: over 425k steps of 144 utterances, the five lowest-resource languages are seen four to six times each and the high-resource languages 1.3 to 2.2 times. With the tail replayed several times, label smoothing of 0.1 ( Szegedy et al., 2016 ) guards against memorisation. To feed this budget, a sequential shard reader streams the corpus from a columnar store: it cuts read amplification from 38 × \times to 0.97 × \times and delivers 449 clips/s per data worker against a training demand of about 180, so the GPUs, not the disks, set the pace.

blocks.en: The final run trains on all 54,643 h (31.24M utterances) for 425k steps with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , cosine decay, the confusability curriculum of Stage IV, bf16 and an EMA of the weights with decay 0.9999, on six RTX A6000 GPUs (Appendix B ). It took 69.6 h, and development accuracy rose to 0.951 at the final checkpoint. SUITE-102 macro-F1 climbs from 0.782 at 25k steps to 0.844 for the final EMA weights (Figure 8 ), but the condition families do not peak together. Clean speech peaks at 75k steps, telephony at 175k, confusable pairs and open-set rejection at 200k, and babble, noise, reverberation and short utterances only at 425k. A single late checkpoint therefore keeps the optima reached at the end of training and gives up the earlier ones. Telephony, for instance, falls from 0.932 at its peak to 0.898 at the final step, and the EMA, with a horizon of about 10k steps, averages only the end of the run. We therefore finalise the model as recent large-scale training recipes do, by averaging weights along the training trajectory ( Izmailov et al., 2018 ; Wortsman et al., 2022 ) . Llama 3 averages checkpoints from its annealing phase ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , and OLMo 2 averages independently annealed runs ( Team OLMo et al., 2024 ) . We archived a checkpoint every 25k steps beside its EMA shadow and scored 31 candidates on all 102 conditions: the 17 checkpoints, six late EMA shadows, five averages over contiguous or diverse subsets, and three soups whose members were fixed from the per-family profiles before any soup was scored. Every average is uniform over parameters and normalisation statistics, accumulated in float64. The best candidate, a soup of seven checkpoints at 100k, 175k, 275k, 325k, 350k, 400k and 425k steps, scores 0.8453 and is the released Anuvani-LID. Against the final checkpoint, it lifts telephony from 0.898 to 0.923 and babble, noise and open-set rejection by 0.6, 0.4 and 0.4 points. It also lowers raw ECE on the all-23 test from 0.077 to 0.054, while no condition family falls by more than 0.5 points. Early members bring back the channel robustness that late training erodes. Because the average is taken in weight space, unlike the output-space fusion of Stage I, it costs nothing at inference.

blocks.en: On the 37 core conditions of SUITE-42, Anuvani-LID reaches 0.914 mean macro-F1 while choosing among all 23 classes (Table 3 ). That is 5.2 points above Gemini 3.5 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and 6.8 above Sarvam Saaras v3 ( Sarvam AI, 2026 ) ; restricted to the APIs’ ten candidates it reaches 0.923 (+6.0 over Gemini, 95% CI [5.7, 6.4]). The best open model, MMS-LID-126 ( Pratap et al., 2024 ) , trails by 8.8 points. Every paired difference excludes zero (McNemar p < 10 − 100 p<10^{-100} over 47,730 clips). Per condition, Anuvani-LID is significantly better than Gemini on 21 of 37 and worse on 9, and better than every open model on at least 28.

blocks.en: Anuvani-LID has the best mean in eight of nine domains (Figure 9 ). Its margin over Gemini is largest on short utterances (0.842 against 0.658), babble (+7.0), noise at 0 dB (+6.0) and reverberation (+4.3), and smallest on clean read speech (+1.9) and telephony (+1.8). It holds cross-corpus on SPRING-INX (0.953 against 0.865). Gemini is significantly better on six long read-speech conditions, the five full-length FLEURS slices and MUCS, by 1.2–5.7 points (Appendix D ); read sentences such as FLEURS’s Wikipedia text ( Conneau et al., 2023 ) offer lexical content an audio LLM can exploit. It is also better on two Hindi-variety probes (§ 7 ).

blocks.en: Duration separates systems most. At one second Anuvani-LID reaches 0.764 macro-F1 on FLEURS and 0.854 in-domain, 24 points above Gemini in both cases (0.520, 0.611). At 0.5 s it reaches 0.545, against 0.439 for Sarvam and 0.231 for Gemini. Duration cropping (Stage III) plausibly explains the gap; some competitors never saw short audio, and Voxlect, for example, was trained on 3–15 s clips ( Feng, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 期限将系统分开的时间最多。 Anuvani-LID在FLEURS上达到0.764个宏-F1,在域内达到0.854个,在两种情况下均高于双子座24分(0.520分,0.611分). 在0.5 s时达到0.545分,而Sarvam为0.439分,双子座为0.231分. 持续收割(Stage III)可以合理解释差距;有些竞争者从未见过短音,例如,Voxlect接受了3至15个剪辑的培训(冯,2025年)。

blocks.en: Only five other systems can in principle output all 23 classes. On the all-23 panel Anuvani-LID averages 0.897 macro-F1, against 0.713 for Voxlect Indic-Whisper, 0.710 for Gemini and 0.384 for GPT-audio. Its F1 exceeds 0.90 on 21 languages, including Bodo, Dogri, Santali, Kashmiri and Sindhi with under 600 h each, and is lowest for Hindi (0.84) and Indian English (0.89) (Figure 10 ). Gains over the better of Gemini and Voxlect are largest for Urdu (+20.5), Dogri (+14.5), Hindi and Kannada (+13.1); only on Tamil is a rival marginally ahead (0.984 against 0.977).
blocks.zh: 原则上只有其他五个系统能够输出所有23个类别。 在全部23个板块上,Anuvani-LID平均为0.897个宏-F1,而Voxlect Indic-Whisper为0.713个;双子座为0.710个;GBT-Audio为0.384个. 其F1在21种语言上超过了0.90种,包括博多语、多格里语、桑塔利语、克什米尔语和信德语,每种语言都低于600小时,印地语(0.84)和印度英语(0.89)最低(图10)。 双子座和Voxlect的优势在乌尔都语(+20.5)、多克里(+14.5)、印地语和坎纳达语(+13.1)方面是最大的;在泰米尔语方面只有略为领先的对手(0.984比0.977)。

blocks.en: The residual errors of Anuvani-LID are linguistically structured (Figure 12 ). On the all-23 test, 61% of errors stay within the reference language’s family, and 73% originate in Indo-Aryan languages.

blocks.en: The largest confusions link the close relatives of § 2 : Hindi → \to Maithili (4.7%) and Maithili → \to Hindi (2.0%), a pair the Census merged until 2001; Urdu → \to Hindi (4.0%) within Hindustani; Dogri to Hindi and Punjabi; Konkani to Marathi (2.3%); and Odia to Assamese (3.3%) and Maithili (2.3%) within the Magadhan cluster. Hindi, whose Census label covers 56 mother tongues, is the hardest class (F1 0.84).
blocks.zh: 最大的混乱将第2节的近亲属联系起来:印地语-和迈蒂利(4.7%)和迈蒂利-和印地语(2.0%),2001年以前人口普查合并了一对;印度斯坦语-乌尔都语-和印地语(4.0%);印度语-多格里语-印地语-旁遮普语-孔卡尼语-马拉地语(2.3%);马加德汉语群内的奥迪亚-阿萨姆语(3.3%)和迈蒂利语(2.3%)。 印地语,其人口普查标签包括56个母语,是最难的一等(F1 0.84).

blocks.en: Other errors cross family but not geographic boundaries. Assamese → \to Bodo (3.0%), Manipuri → \to Bodo (2.7%), Nepali → \to Manipuri (2.3%) and Santali → \to Assamese involve languages in long contact in north-eastern India; Assamese, for example, has many Bodo-related words ( Mahanta, 2012 ) . Such areal similarity ( Emeneau, 1956 ; Thomason, 2000 ) is invisible in a family tree, though shared recording regions may also contribute.
blocks.zh: 其他错误跨越家族界限,但不是地理界限。 阿萨姆语 →到博多(3.0%),马尼普里语 \到博多(2.7%),尼泊尔语 \到马尼普里语 (2.3%)和桑塔利语 \到阿萨姆语  in到印度东北部的长距离接触语言;以阿萨姆语为例,阿萨姆语有许多与博多相通的词汇(Mahanta,2012). 这种对等相似性(Emeneau,1956年;Thomason,2000年)在一棵家庭树上是看不见的,尽管共享记录区也可能有所贡献.

blocks.en: English is confused mainly with Hindi (2.7%), Santali (2.0%) and Marathi (1.7%). This matches the L1-conditioned phonology of Indian English ( Masica, 1972 ; Wiltshire and Harnsberger, 2006 ) . The same effect is stronger on Svarah, whose 117 speakers cover 19 first languages ( Javed et al., 2023b ) : 40% of its accented-English utterances are attributed to a scheduled language, spread over many classes.
blocks.zh: 英语主要与印地语(2.7%),桑塔利语(2.0%)和马拉地语(1.7%)相混淆. 这与印度英语的L1条件相匹配(Masica,1972;Wiltshire and Harnsberger,2006.). Svarah也有同样的效果, 117位演讲者涵盖19种第一语言(Javed等, 2023b. ): 40%的重口音-英语的发音都归于一种排班语言,

blocks.en: The one SUITE-42 domain where other systems lead is Hindi varieties, and here too Anuvani-LID errs along linguistic lines: 19% of dialectal Hindi (Lahaja) is labelled Urdu, and Hinglish (HiACC) goes 28% to Urdu, which shares Hindi’s spoken grammar, and 23% to English, which supplies its embedded words. These single-language probes reward any prior towards the probed class, and the prompted APIs could not answer “English”. Under the matched protocol, Anuvani-LID’s HiACC macro-F1 rises from 0.551 to 0.729, and on the balanced confusable conditions it leads Gemini (0.975 against 0.955). Colloquial Hindi and Urdu share one form ( Kachru, 2008 ) , so the choice between them is largely sociolinguistic, and code-mixed speech calls for frame-level language diarization ( Baghel et al., 2023 ; Dey et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 其他系统领先的SUITE-42域是印地语品种,在这里,阿努瓦尼-LID在语言学上也有错误:19%的方言印地语(Lahaja)被标为乌尔都语,而Hinglish(HiACC)则占28%,乌尔都语使用印地语语言语法,而英语则占23%,后者提供其嵌入词。 这些单一语言的探测器会奖励任何在探测类之前的,被激发的API无法回答"英语". 根据相应的协议,Anuvani-LID的HIACC宏F1从0.551上升到了0.729,在平衡的可信任条件下,它导致双子座(0.975比0.955). Collogueal Indian and Urdu 分享了一种形式(Kachru,2008年),所以他们之间的选择主要是社会语言,而代号混合的演讲则要求帧级语言分化(Baghel等,2023;Dey等,2022年).

blocks.en: 8 Where Is Language Identity Encoded?
blocks.zh: 8 语言身份编码在哪里?

blocks.en: We probe pooled block outputs ( Belinkov, 2022 ) , inspect the learned aggregation weights and truncate the encoder (Figure 13 ), and we knock out single blocks. The full-scale subject is the first 54.6k h checkpoint of the recipe.
blocks.zh: 我们探索集合块输出(Belinkov, 2022年), 检查所学到的集合分量并截取编码器(图13), 全程主题 菜谱前54.6k h检查点.

blocks.en: Language lives mid-to-upper stack. In the pre-trained encoder, probe macro-F1 peaks at about 0.56 in blocks 9–11 and collapses to 0.13 at block 17, whose representations serve the pre-training objective ( Pasad et al., 2021 ) . Fine-tuning moves the peak to block 11 (0.69) at 1,000 h and block 12 (0.86) at 54.6k h, higher than the lower-layer optimum reported for an SSL Conformer by Bartley et al. (2023) . Aggregation buys robustness. At full scale block 17 receives 30% of the learned weight and blocks 10–16 most of the rest; no single-block knockout then costs more than 0.08 macro-F1, whereas bypassing block 7 costs a last-block model 0.34. Channel is not the cue. Corpus identity stays linearly decodable at the top (0.90; majority 0.25), yet erasing its rank-3 subspace with LEACE ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) changes LID macro-F1 by only +0.1 points, so the decision does not rest on the channel cues behind earlier cross-corpus failures ( Dey et al., 2021 ) . Twelve blocks suffice. Truncation saturates at k = 12 k{=}12 (0.848 with 84M parameters against 0.840 with all 17 blocks and 116M; 0.844 against 0.835 at four epochs with two seeds).
blocks.zh: 语言活在中上层堆栈. 在预训编码器中,探测宏-F1的峰值为9–11区块约0.56,而第17区块则倒塌至0.13,其表述服务于预训目标(Pasad等,2021年). 微调将峰值移动至1000h的11(0.69)和54.6kh的12(0.86),高于巴特利等人(2023年)报告的SSL Conformer的下层最佳. 相加能取坚固. 在全尺度第17区块获得30%的学分重量,其余大部分为10至16区块;没有单一区块的淘汰费用超过0.08个宏-F1,而绕行第7区块则需要最后一个区块型号0.34。 频道不是提示 公司身份在顶端(0.90;多数为0.25)仍可进行线性解码,但用LEACE(Belrose等,2023年)去除其排名-3子空间仅以+0.1分改变LID宏-F1,因此决定不停留在先前跨公司失败的后方通道提示上(Dey等,2021年). 12个街区就够了。 短道速滑饱和分数为k=12 k{=}12(0.848 有84M参数,而所有17个区块为0.840,有116M;在有2个种子的四个纪元上,0.844对0.835).

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Language identification is not yet a solved by-product of scale. For India’s 22 scheduled languages and Indian English, the generalist systems we tested lack classes, collapse on short inputs or return uncalibrated labels. A dedicated 116M-parameter model, designed on held-out, multi-axis conditions, does better on each count. Its residual errors follow the genealogy and contact history of India’s languages, making code-switching, dialect continua and unseen relatives the next frontier.
blocks.zh: 语言识别还不是规模的解决副产品. 印度22种语言和印度英语, 专用的116M参数模型在被搁置的多轴条件下设计,在每个计数上效果更好. 其残存的误差跟随了印度语言的分系和联系历史,使得密码开关、方言和看不见的亲属成为了下一个前沿。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Anuvani-LID assigns one label per utterance. For code-switched speech such as Hinglish this is ill-posed. Frame-level language diarization ( Baghel et al., 2023 ) is the appropriate formulation, and our HiACC and Lahaja probes show that single-label scoring penalises acoustic models on mixed and dialectal Hindi.
blocks.zh: Anuvani-LID每句话都指定一个标签。 对于像Hinglish这样的密码切换语句,这是不正确的。 框架级语言分化(Baghel等,2023年)是适当的配方,我们的HIACC和Lahaja探测器显示,单标签评分对混合和方言印地语上的声学模型进行惩罚.

blocks.en: The label set covers the 22 scheduled languages and Indian English. India’s many other languages (Bhili, Gondi, Tulu, Bhojpuri and others) are outside it. Our open-set results show that rejecting close relatives of scheduled languages, such as Chhattisgarhi, is harder than rejecting unrelated languages.
blocks.zh: 该标签集涵盖了22种预定语言和印度英语. 印度的许多其他语言(比利语,贡地语,图鲁语,博日普里语等)都位于外. 我们的开放式结果显示,拒绝 Chhatisgarhi 等预定语言的近亲比拒绝无关语言更难。

blocks.en: SUITE-102 includes one licensed in-domain comparator (LDC-IL; Choudhary, 2021 ). All held-out generalisation tiers use public corpora and can be rebuilt from our scripts. Kathbath shares 4 of 456 speakers with training and is therefore reported only as an in-domain comparator. Commercial APIs return hard labels, so we compare them on macro-F1 and accuracy but not on calibration or C avg C_{\text{avg}} , and their behaviour may change between versions. We report the API versions and dates of our runs in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: SUITE-102包括一个获得执照的域内比较国(LDC-IL;Choudhary,2021.)。 所有被搁置的泛化层 都使用公共公司 可以从我们的剧本重建 Kathbath在456名演讲者中共有4人接受培训,因此只报告为国内比较者。 商业API返回硬标签,因此我们在宏-F1和精度上比较,但不在校正或Cavg C_{\text{avg}}}上比较,它们的行为可能会在版本之间发生变化. 我们在附录C中报告了API版本和运行日期。

blocks.en: Stages I–V used single runs per arm. We measured run-to-run variance and interpret effects accordingly, but small within-stage differences remain provisional. Stage VI was trained once. Its checkpoint trajectory and the unselected-checkpoint check indicate that the conclusions do not hinge on selection, but we did not repeat full-scale training with other seeds. Sub-second LID remains information-limited. At 0.25 s Anuvani-LID reaches 0.24–0.35 macro-F1 in seven of the eight 0.25 s conditions, and no open model exceeds 0.18 where it can be scored.
blocks.zh: 第一至第五阶段每臂使用单跑. 我们测得运行中的差异并据此解释影响,但阶段内的小差异仍然是暂时的. 第六阶段曾接受过一次培训。 其检查站轨迹和未经选择的检查站检查表明,结论并不取决于选择,但我们没有用其他种子重复全面训练。 次秒LID仍然信息有限. 在0.25 s Anuvani-LID在8个0.25 s条件中的7个条件中达到0.24–0.35 宏-F1,没有开放型号超过能得分的0.18.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All training and evaluation data come from published corpora under their licences. The one licensed comparator is used for evaluation only. We use no private user audio: the production-mix condition is a held-out sample of the public training corpora in their deployment proportions. Language identification can be misused to profile speakers by language, region or community. It is also a prerequisite for providing services in citizens’ own languages, and it is where current systems are least reliable for speakers of low-resource scheduled languages. We therefore report per-language results for all 23 classes, and we do not recommend using LID output as a proxy for ethnicity, religion or nationality. Hindi and Urdu, in particular, share a spoken register, so an utterance’s label should not be read as a statement about its speaker’s identity. Where speaker gender is recorded, about one third of the training speech is female. We did not evaluate gender-sliced performance in this paper and flag it as necessary future work. Training the final model took about three days on six GPUs.
blocks.zh: 所有培训和评价数据都来自根据许可证公布的公司。 有执照的比较者只用于评价。 我们没有使用私人用户的音频:制作-混合条件是公共培训公司部署比例的搁置样本。 语言识别可能被滥用,用于按语言、区域或社区描述发言者。 它也是用公民自己的语言提供服务的先决条件,而对于讲低资源预定语言的人来说,目前的系统最不可靠。 因此,我们报告所有23个阶层的每个语文结果,我们不建议使用LID产出作为族裔、宗教或国籍的代名词。 印地语和乌尔都语尤其共用一个口语登记册,因此,不应将口语的标签理解为有关其发言人身份的声明。 在录制演讲人性别时,大约三分之一的演讲是女性。 我们没有在本文件中评价性别偏见的表现,并把它定为今后的必要工作。 最终型号的培训在6个GPU上花了大约3天时间.
